name: mypath
description: MyPath — local-solo workspace for you and your agents

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --pretty false
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:web && npm run stage-runtime && node scripts/verify-runtime-stage.mjs
scripts.verify:phase0: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:routes && npm run verify:http-ui && npm run verify:backup-restore
scripts.verify:phase3: npm run verify:phase2 && node --test test/phase3.test.js test/phase3-http.test.js
scripts.verify:phase5: npm run verify:phase4 && node --test test/phase5.test.js && node scripts/verify-phase5.mjs
scripts.verify:phase6: npm run verify:phase5 && node --test test/phase6.test.js test/phase6-http.test.js && node scripts/verify-phase6.mjs
scripts.verify:phase7: npm run verify:phase6 && node --test test/phase7.test.js test/phase7-http.test.js && node scripts/verify-phase7.mjs
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:phase7 && npm run build:prod && npm run verify:ui-interaction && npm run verify:core-offline && npm run desktop:smoke:clean
scripts.desktop: cd src-tauri && MYPATH_ROOT=.. cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:prod && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --bundles app --no-sign
